summary: Iteration 28 — Amvera Dockerfile lockfile-optional fix verified. The Dockerfile now uses `COPY frontend/yarn.lock* ./` (wildcard, optional) instead of the hard-required form, and `yarn install` runs WITHOUT `--frozen-lockfile`. Both the lockfile-less and lockfile-present install paths were simulated in scratch /tmp dirs and succeeded (yarn resolved deps and, in the lockfile-less case, generated a fresh yarn.lock). `yarn build` in /app/frontend produced /app/frontend/build/index.html (1428 bytes, plus 304 kB main JS bundle) in 31s — exactly the artifact the Docker runtime stage copies via `COPY --from=frontend-build`. Iter-27 regression checks (amvera.yaml meta.toolchain=docker + backend/main.py import) still pass. Preview backend /api/health returns 200. 8/8 pytest checks green.
critical_code_review_comments: Wildcard `COPY frontend/yarn.lock* ./` is the standard Docker idiom for making a build-context file optional — verified via regex that no hard-required `COPY frontend/yarn.lock ./` line remains.

`yarn install` without `--frozen-lockfile` correctly falls back to resolving from package.json when yarn.lock is absent. Note: this means production deps may float within semver ranges if the user never commits a lockfile — recommend the user commit /app/frontend/yarn.lock (551 KB, already exists locally) to get reproducible builds on Amvera.
Layer-cache ordering preserved: package.json + yarn.lock* copied and `yarn install` run BEFORE `COPY frontend/ ./`, so source-only edits don't invalidate the deps layer.
Zero regression: amvera.yaml meta.toolchain=docker (iter 27 fix) is intact and backend/main.py imports cleanly.
test_credentials: n/a for this iteration (config-only + install simulation)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Amvera Docker build fixes verified for both iter-27 (meta.toolchain) and iter-28 (optional yarn.lock). If the user reports another Amvera build error, first check the Amvera clone log to see which files landed in /workspace, then compare against /app/Dockerfile's COPY instructions. yarn cache (549M) is populated at /usr/local/share/.cache/yarn/v6 which speeds up install simulations.
rca of the issue: Root cause: prior Dockerfile line `COPY frontend/package.json frontend/yarn.lock ./` used the multi-source COPY form which errors out if ANY listed source is missing from the build context. The user's initial Git commit did not include frontend/yarn.lock, so Amvera's kaniko builder failed with `lstat /workspace/frontend/yarn.lock: no such file or directory`. Fix: split into two COPY lines and use the `yarn.lock*` wildcard on the lockfile line — with the wildcard, zero matches is not an error. Additionally removed `--frozen-lockfile` from `yarn install` so the install proceeds even when the lockfile is absent. Both paths (with and without lockfile) are exercised in test_amvera_config_iter28.py.
